items.title: Glamrock Bonnie
items.summary: Glamrock Bonnie, also known as just Bonnie, was a glamrock counterpart of Bonnie who was mentioned in Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach and made an official appearance in the RUIN DLC.

items.title: Henry Emily (Film)
items.summary: Henry Emily is a major character in the 2025 film Five Nights at Freddy's 2.  He is the former business partner of William Afton and the father of the late Charlotte Emily.

items.title: Freddy Fazbear's Pizza (Film)
items.summary: Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, often called River Freddy's by crew, is a prominent location in the 2025 film Five Nights at Freddy's 2.  It was a family restaurant and entertainment pizzeria opened between late 1970s and 1982 by Fazbear…

items.title: Warehouse (FNaF: SotM)
items.summary: The Warehouse is a location in Murray's Costume Manor.  It's where the Mimic wearing the Party Time Chica costume is first encountered.
